description: Recent Suunto workouts, newest first (auto-paginated up to limit). Per item: workoutKey, activityId (numeric, no sport name; get_workout_fit has session.sport), startTime (epoch ms), totalTime (s), distance/ascent/descent (m), energyConsumption (kcal), hrdata {avg, max} (max is the account's overall max HR; hrdata.workoutMaxHR is this workout's), summary/intensity extensions. Laps: get_workout_laps.

since.description: ISO 8601 lower bound on startTime (inclusive). Same as `from` (preferred); both given and different is an error.

until.description: ISO 8601 upper bound on startTime (inclusive). Same as `to` (preferred); both given and different is an error.

name: list_workouts
title: List workouts
